answers.reason: The student representative is elected only at the faculty level and does not hold a university-wide office.
Budget planning is a central administration and leadership matter where a faculty student representative has no seat.
As the elected representative of the faculty's students, this person holds a seat on faculty committees such as the appointment committee.
The student representative was elected by the students of the faculty to speak for them in the faculty's main governing body.
The study commission deals with teaching and degree programmes in the faculty, where the elected student representative speaks for the students.
The elected student representative holds a formal office representing faculty students and takes part in faculty bodies dealing with student examination matters.
Internal research funding is an academic research matter and does not provide a seat for a student representative.
Having a faculty-level representative office in teaching matters permits participation in subordinate working groups on study programmes.
Equipment procurement is an administrative and staff matter without a regulated seat for student representatives.
Planning the orientation week for new students directly concerns student affairs within the faculty, permitting the student representative to take part.
